negative_results: refuse_orientation_as_unique: the point-group-32 symmetry leaves a six-member alias set with identical cheap-bench observations, so a unique orientation is refused (test_refuse_orientation_as_unique_raises).

refuse_optic_axis_polarity: the optic axis is an undirected line; +c and -c are indistinguishable, so the 180-degree ambiguity is intrinsic and the c-axis sign is refused (test_optic_axis_is_a_line_both_signs_in_alias_set, test_refuse_optic_axis_polarity_always_raises).

refuse_handedness_from_geometry: P3_121 and P3_221 share all achiral observables, so handedness is returned UNDETERMINED regardless of the plant and cannot be inferred from the c-axis (test_handedness_is_never_recovered_regardless_of_plant, test_enantiomorphs_are_indistinguishable_on_the_bench).

solve_orientation out-of-budget refusal: a fit whose residual exceeds the k=2 expanded uncertainty (~3.742 deg) is refused; noise of 12 deg per facet yields no orientation (test_noise_beyond_budget_is_refused).

refuse_certificate_confirmed_without_xrd and confidence cap: a no-diffraction certificate is capped at PRESUMPTIVE; an XRD_CONFIRMED request is refused (test_certificate_confidence_is_capped_without_xrd, test_refuse_confirmed_certificate_without_xrd_raises).
AcquisitionMode.REAL refused: no physical goniometer exists here (test_real_acquisition_mode_is_refused).
